title: NFTopia
tagline: An NFT marketplace fusing the power of DAO and AI, that encourages reviewing NFT to earn reward,  and provides smart insights to help buyers make better decisions.
description:
Hi, we are NFTopia. 

We are building an NFT marketplace, fusing the power of DAO and AI, that encourages reviewing NFT to earn reward, and provides smart insights to help buyers make better decisions. 

For each collection, our marketplace automatically generates a proposal, all of our token holders - our own ERC-721 based governance token, can provide a review and a rating for each collection. All reviews and final rating will be publicly viewable after proposal ends.

On the AI side, our DNN models is trained to extracts the visual features in numeric form from images of NFT collections and associates them with a list of pre-defined tags. When NFTs in a new collection are minted, it identifies the most plausible tags and also generates a novelty score to reflect how creative this NFT collection is based on all existing collections.
how_its_made: We based on top of the Moralis boiler plate, and used openzepplin's governance contract to support our DAO.
